svg.title: With the section norm, (IC8) reads ∥bxk,N,p,ν∥= ∥xk,N,p,ν∥≤Dk. The exceptional early refinements use the prescribed unit tuple on both sides. Their completion has no role in the eventual comparison estimate. For each selected kn there is one threshold N0(kn) for the finite panel, with quantifier order ∀n ∃N0(kn) ∀N ≥max{kn, N0(kn)} ∀p.
